_note: Screens of the board (v2, route #/bwrdd), owned by package 11. Engine sentences live in board.json (package 10).
doc.title: The board: South East Wales. Etifeddiaeth
narrow.title: The board needs a bigger screen
narrow.body: Play it on a laptop or a tablet held sideways. The atlas works on a phone.
error.title: The board did not load. Check your connection, then try again.
error.broken: Something went wrong on the board.
fixture.note: This is a practice board of three councils. Link sizes and project numbers are illustrative, not real figures.
fixture.short: Practice board: three councils, illustrative numbers.
start.mapAria: Map of {region}. The councils in this game are outlined.
start.pitch: You run South East Wales from 2026 to 2050. You play on the map.
start.pitch2: Time runs on its own, and you can pause it at any moment. What you build stays and grows. Its effects travel along real railways, rivers and commutes.
start.length: {years} years on a clock you can pause. About 15 to 20 minutes. Game number {n}.
start.honest: Every 2026 figure is real and has a source. After 2026 the scores are game estimates, not a forecast.
start.v1: Play the first game instead: all of Wales, cards and four-year turns
strip.backersTip: Colour the map by who backs you
map.aria: Map of the region. Click a council to see it.
map.backing: Backing: {n} out of 10. It backs you at {at} or more.
map.status: Showing the whole region. Click a council to see it and build there.
map.statusSelected: Showing {name}. Click the sea to see the whole region.
colour.label: Colour the map by
colour.backingNote: Points out of 10. A council backs you at {n} or more. A game estimate.
colour.behindNote: All six scores together, against the middle council.
colour.real: Points out of 10, from real figures for 2026.
colour.estimate: Points out of 10. A game estimate, not a forecast.
forecast.ready: Projects that cut it by half: {list}.
region.ask: Which place needs you first? The list starts with the place furthest behind.
region.leagueNote: The first figure is all six scores together. The second is backing, out of 10: a council backs you at {at} or more. Game estimates after 2026.
council.backing: Backing {n} out of 10. A council backs you at {at} or more.
council.realNote: These are the real figures for 2026. They do not change in the game.
council.groupsNote: People can be in more than one group. Moods are a game estimate.
council.noProjects: Nothing of yours stands here yet.
council.visit: A place here is asking you to visit
link.rail: {line}: trains run on into the {other} council area. Trains: {quality}.
build.title: Build in {name}
build.keystone: Keystone: the top of this branch
build.running: Running cost: about {n} coins a year.
build.goFree: Build it: free, your head start
need.tier: Opens when {n} {tier} projects of {branch} are working.
need.tierOpen: Needs the {tier} projects of {branch} to be open.
block.oneKeystone: There is only one of each keystone. This one is built already.
block.stillBuilding: It is still being built. You can make it bigger once it works, from {when}.
block.tooLate: Too late: it would not be working by 2050. The last season to start it was {when}.
block.lawUsed: You have used this term's law change.
preview.title: If you build this
preview.none: No score moves straight away. See what it does above.
preview.links: Travels along: {list}. Lit on the map.
preview.honest: About. A game estimate, not a forecast.
tree.title: What you can build
tree.note: Each branch climbs from starter projects, to bigger ones, to its keystone at the top. A step opens when enough of the step below are working, anywhere in the region.
laws.title: Laws
laws.note: A law costs no coins. It costs backing in some councils, for as long as the law stands. Each law shows where, before you choose. Changes left this term: {n}.
report.none: Nothing changed by a quarter of a point or more.
report.toEnd: To 2050: see the Wales you built
election.count: of {of} councils back you. They hold {people} in 100 of the people.
election.rule: A council backs you at {n} out of 10 or more. You win if they hold more than half the people.
election.honest: Backing is a game estimate. Population shares are real, for 2026.
why.title: Why did {measure} change in {council}?
why.none: No change of this size was recorded here in these years.
why.foot: This is a rough guide for the region, not a count of homes or people.
why.book: Read the rules in the rule book
via.commute: workers who live in {from} and travel to work
cause.drift: Things that get worse on their own.
timeline.aria: The years from 2026 to 2050: what has happened, now, and what is ahead
strip.lifeTip: How the years feel on the way, for the people living them. People judge you on this at elections. A game estimate.
settings.title: The clock
settings.stepNote: No running clock. You move on one season at a time, or to the next moment.
settings.hold: Hold the clock while I read.
settings.holdNote: The build menu, the branches, the laws and Why? hold it. Closing them carries on.
settings.hidden: The clock always stops when you leave this page.
settings.stop.respond: something lands that needs an answer
settings.stop.visit: a place asks you to visit
settings.stop.tipping: a council starts to rise or to slip
settings.stop.deal_due: a deal has a year left
settings.keys: Keys: Space plays and pauses. 1, 2 and 3 set the speed. Full stop moves one season while paused.
stop.warning.title: A warning
stop.keystone.title: A keystone stands
stop.keystone.line: {project} is finished in {council}. Things change from here.
stop.tier_open.title: A new tier is open
stop.tier_open.line: Tier {tier} of {branch} is open. See it in the build menu.
stop.visit.title: A place asks you to visit
stop.visit.line: {place} in {council} asks you to visit and make one choice.
stop.tipping.title: A council has turned
stop.tipping.line: {council} has changed course. See the mark on the map.
stop.tipping.rising: {council} is on the rise. Young adults and work start to come in, and it backs you a little more each year.
stop.tipping.slipping: {council} is slipping. People and work start to leave, and its backing falls a little each year.
stop.chapter.title: A new chapter
stop.chapter.line: The game has named these years.
stop.deal_due.title: A deal is nearly due
stop.deal_due.line: A year is left on your deal with {council}.
stop.purse_full.title: Your purse is full
stop.purse_full.line: Coins above the limit are not paid. Spend some to keep them coming.
stop.finished.title: Finished
stop.year.title: A year has ended
stop.year.line: See the ticker for what changed, and why.
deal.title: You govern with others
deal.ask: Pick one deal. You keep it by building: the project that keeps it costs {off} coin less.
deal.note: Kept: backing in that council rises by {kept}, and by {near} next door. Broken: backing there falls by {broken}, and that fades over {fade} years. A game rule.
term.label: Term {n}: {from} to {to}
term.honest: The game's own telling of your run, from what happened on the board.
term.linesAria: What changed most in these four years
ticker.first: Nothing moves until you press Start time.
timeline.mark.keystone_last_start: The last season to start a keystone: {when}.
council.freshStart: A fresh start here: the first project you place costs less, and grows as if it had neighbours.
council.youngGone: About {n} in 100 of the young adults here in 2026 have gone.
council.youngCome: About {n} in 100 more young adults live here than in 2026.
build.quick: A small win: works within a year
build.anyTime: Build at any time, running or paused.
respond.held: The clock waits until you answer.
forecast.cut: Something you built already cuts it.
cause.momentum: A council on the rise or slipping.
cause.dealBroken: Your broken deal with {council}. The anger fades over {fade} years.
start.result: Your result is the Wales you leave in 2050. People judge you on the years in between.
why.ruleLink: Read this rule in the rule book
stop.ended.title: The end
stop.ended.line: Your time is up. See the Wales you built.
stop.election.title: An election
stop.election.line: The election is in. See who backs you.
need.project.within_link: Needs {project} working here or one link away first.
need.project.anywhere: Needs {project} working somewhere in the region first.
need.keystone: Opens when {project} is working. It is the keystone, the top project, of {branch}.
need.anyKeystone: Opens when any keystone, the top project of a branch, is working.
need.measure.below: Only where {measure} is below {n} out of 10.
need.measure.at_least: Needs {measure} at {n} out of 10 or more here.
need.measure.rising: Needs {measure} to be getting better here.
need.share.young_adults.below: Only where fewer than {n} in 100 people are young adults.
need.share.young_adults.at_least: Needs at least {n} in 100 people here to be young adults.
need.share.age65.below: Only where fewer than {n} in 100 people are 65 or over.
need.share.age65.at_least: Needs at least {n} in 100 people here to be 65 or over.
need.backing.below: Only where backing is below {n} out of 10.
need.backing.at_least: Needs backing of {n} out of 10 or more here.
need.track: Only in some years, depending on {track}.
need.momentum.rising: Only where the council is on the rise.
need.momentum.slipping: Only where the council is slipping.
need.momentum.steady: Only where the council is steady.
flag.heartland: a place where most people speak Welsh
path.ready: The keystone is open. Start it by {when}: it takes {years} years.
path.tooLate: Too late to start it now: a keystone must start by {when}.
build.offFresh: A fresh start: your first project here only.
council.mapRing.one: A ring: a build here, working from {when}.
council.mapRing.other: {n} builds here or on its railways, shown by {rings} rings. The first works from {when}. A number in a ring counts the builds at that spot.
council.mapTip.rising: A black arrow up: it is on the rise.
council.mapTip.slipping: A red arrow down: it is slipping.
council.mapWarn: A dashed circle is a warning, from {when}: {noun}.
council.mapStitch.one: A blue mark: your project working here.
council.mapStitch.other: {n} blue marks: your projects working here.
election.means.title: What each result means for the next {years} years
election.means.strong_win: Won well: two law changes, and builds go faster where you are backed.
election.means.win: Won: one law change, and no deal to keep.
election.means.lost: Lost: no law changes, and you must keep a deal with one council. Kept, backing there rises by {kept}. Broken, it falls by {broken} there, fading over {fade} years.
election.means.note: Whatever the result, your coins and projects stay. Game rules.
cause.young: Young adults move towards work and homes. Work and pay plus Homes and community, out of 20: {here} about {a}, {other} about {b}.
cause.youngHere: Young adults move towards work and homes. Work and pay plus Homes and community in {here}: about {a} out of 20.
cause.peopleSome: People here moving or changing their minds, as the rule below says.
cause.momentumNow.rising: {council} is on the rise: its scores have climbed for four years.
cause.momentumNow.slipping: {council} is slipping: its scores have fallen for four years.
ticker.firstStep: Nothing moves until you press Next season.
gate.oneAnywhere: Opens when {project} is working somewhere in the region.
gate.oneCouncils: Opens when {project} is working in {n} different councils.
gate.oneLines: Opens when {project} is working on {n} different lines.
gate.many: Opens when {n} {tier} projects of {branch} are working, anywhere in the region. The same project in two councils counts as two.
path.here.ready: You can build it in {council} now. Start it by {when}: it takes {years} years.
path.here.not: The keystone is open, but you cannot build it in {council} yet. {why}
tree.afterNote: This opens only once the keystone works. It does not count towards the keystone.
build.alreadyHereNote: These stand here already. An upgrade makes one bigger. It is not a new build.
build.upgradeLine: Already built here. This makes it bigger: level {from} to {to} of 3.
build.freshHead: A fresh start here: your first project here costs less. After that, projects here cost their full price.
preview.opensVia: {council}: {measure} {d}, from {when}, when it opens, along a link.
preview.felt: {council}: {measure} {d}, from {when}, once it has bedded in.
preview.feltVia: {council}: {measure} {d}, from {when}, once it has bedded in, along a link.
laws.backers: Councils that back you: {now} of {of} now, {after} after.
deal.must: Have a project that lifts {measure} working in {council} by {when}.
deal.keptBy: Your deal with {council} was kept: {project} lifts {measure} there.
deal.keptBacking: Backing there rose by {kept}, and by {near} next door.
deal.broken: Your deal with {council} was broken: nothing that lifts {measure} was working there by {when}.
deal.brokenBacking: Backing there fell by {broken}. The anger fades over {fade} years.
council.momentumWhy.rising: Its six scores together are up {at} or more on {years} years ago. Young adults and work come in, and its projects grow faster. It backs you a little more each year. It adds about {coins} coin a year to your purse. A game rule.
council.momentumWhy.slipping: Its six scores together are down {at} or more on {years} years ago. Young adults and work leave, and its projects grow slower. Its backing falls a little each year until it turns. A game rule.
region.nothingNow: Nothing is being built just now.
